$comment: The test build. `node --test` runs JavaScript, so the TypeScript is compiled
first — there is no test-runner dependency here, no transform pipeline and no
jsdom. Node 22 ships the runner; React ships a server renderer.
Emitting CommonJS on purpose: it makes `require` resolve workspace packages
through node_modules, which is how the compiled tests reach @booknasi/tokens
without a path-mapping shim at runtime.
